overview: The NPC core subsystem implements a data-driven behavior tree architecture for all non-player characters in Hytale. It uses the server's ECS framework (EntityStore) with NPCEntity as the primary component. NPCs are governed by Roles (behavior configurations loaded from JSON), which compose Actions, Sensors, BodyMotions, and HeadMotions into Instructions that are evaluated each tick. A Blackboard provides shared world-state views (block types, events, attitudes, resources, interactions). A utility-AI StateEvaluator periodically scores StateOptions using Conditions to select the best behavioral state. State transitions can execute prioritised action lists. The PositionCache system pre-computes spatial queries for nearby players, NPCs, and items each tick. All NPC core components follow a Builder pattern — each runtime type has a corresponding Builder* class that reads JSON configuration and constructs the instance.

core_components.overview: Core components are the behavioral building blocks that compose NPC instructions. They fall into five hierarchies rooted in AnnotatedComponentBase: Actions (things NPCs do), Sensors (things NPCs perceive), BodyMotions (body movement behaviors), HeadMotions (head orientation behaviors), and EntityFilters (criteria for selecting/filtering entities). There are also WeightedActions for probabilistic selection. Each concrete type has a corresponding Builder* class for JSON deserialization. There are 327 total Java files in corecomponents (162 non-builder types, 165 builder types).

patterns.builder_pattern: Every concrete component type has a corresponding Builder* class. Builders extend BuilderBase and implement readConfig(JsonElement) to parse JSON, then build(BuilderSupport) to create runtime instances.
patterns.once_trigger_pattern: Both ActionBase and SensorBase support a 'once' flag. When set, the component only fires once until clearOnce() is called at the start of each tick cycle.
patterns.entity_filter_cost_ordering: IEntityFilter implementations declare a cost() value. Filters are sorted ascending by cost before evaluation, enabling early-out: cheap checks (NPCGroup = MINIMAL 0) run before expensive checks (LineOfSight = EXTREME 400).
patterns.info_provider_chain: Sensors produce InfoProvider objects carrying position data, parameter providers, and extra info. These are passed to actions so they know where/what the sensor detected.

state_transitions.overview: State transitions define actions that execute when an NPC changes from one behavioral state to another. Transitions are stored as a map from (fromState, toState) edge pairs to prioritised action lists.

types.name: StateTransitionController
types.purpose: Runtime controller managing state transition action lists. Map of (fromState<<16 | toState) -> IActionListHolder. initiateStateTransition() starts and runTransitionActions() executes on subsequent ticks.

types.name: BuilderStateTransition
types.purpose: Builder for a single transition entry with state edges and action list.

types.name: BuilderStateTransitionEdges
types.purpose: Builder for From/To state arrays and priority.

state_transitions.mechanism: When setState() is called with a different state, StateTransitionController looks up the (from, to) edge. If found, runningActions is set. On subsequent ticks, runTransitionActions() executes the action list. Normal instruction evaluation is deferred while isRunningTransitionActions() is true.

decision_making.overview: Utility AI approach. StateEvaluator (ECS component) periodically evaluates StateOptions scored by Conditions using response curves. The highest-scoring option determines behavioral state.

types.name: Evaluator<OptionType>

types.name: StateOption

types.name: Option
types.purpose: Abstract evaluatable option with conditions and weight coefficient. calculateUtility() multiplies condition scores with compensation factor.

types.name: EvaluationContext
types.purpose: Per-evaluation context: minimumUtility, minimumWeightCoefficient, predictability (0-1), lastUsedNanos.

types.purpose: Extends EventSupport with flock awareness.

types.name: BeaconSupport
types.purpose: Named beacon message slots.

types.name: NPCBlockEventSupport
types.purpose: Block events from NPC sources.

types.name: NPCEntityEventSupport
types.purpose: Entity events from NPC sources.

types.name: PlayerBlockEventSupport
types.purpose: Block events from player sources.

types.name: PlayerEntityEventSupport
types.purpose: Entity events from player sources.

validators.overview: 2 validation types for NPC role configuration integrity.

types.name: NPCLoadTimeValidationHelper
types.purpose: Validates animations, motion controllers, inventory slots, filters, value store conflicts during role building.

types.name: NPCRoleValidator
types.purpose: Late validator checking if a role name references a valid spawnable role.

valuestore.overview: Runtime key-value storage for NPC behavioral state.

types.name: ValueStore
types.purpose: ECS component: string[], int[], double[] arrays indexed by slot. Builder allocates slots.

types.name: ValueStoreValidator
types.purpose: Validates write conflicts at load time.

storage.overview: Persistent parameter storage serialized with NPC data.

types.name: PersistentParameter<Type>
types.purpose: Abstract: setting marks chunk dirty for save.

types.name: ParameterStore<Type>
types.purpose: Named HashMap store with auto-create on access.

types.name: AlarmStore
types.purpose: ParameterStore<Alarm> for persistent alarm timers.

metadata.overview: 1 type for captured NPC display metadata.

types.name: CapturedNPCMetadata
types.purpose: Icon paths and name keys for captured NPCs in items.
